96:     #[tool(description = "Register a new account. Returns JWT token for authentication.")]
97:     async fn auth_register(
98:         &self,
99:         params: Parameters<RegisterInput>,
100:     ) -> Result<Json<RegisterOutput>, String> {
101:         let input = params.0;
102:         // Rate limit by email
103:         self.state.rate_limiter.check(&input.email).await.map_err(|e| format!("Rate limited: {e}"))?;
104: 
105:         if input.email.is_empty() || !input.email.contains('@') {
106:             return Err("Invalid email".into());
107:         }
108:         if input.password.len() < 6 {
109:             return Err("Password must be at least 6 characters".into());
110:         }
111: 
112:         if queries::get_user_by_email(&self.state.db, &input.email)
113:             .await
114:             .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
115:             .is_some()
116:         {
117:             return Err("Email already registered".into());
118:         }
119: 
120:         let hash = jwt::hash_password(&input.password).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
121:         let user = queries::create_user(&self.state.db, &input.email, &hash, &input.name)
122:             .await
123:             .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
124: 
125:         let token = jwt::create_token(user.id, &self.state.config.jwt_secret)
126:             .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
127: 
128:         Ok(Json(RegisterOutput {
129:             token,
130:             user_id: user.id.to_string(),
131:             name: user.name,
132:         }))
133:     }
134: 
135:     #[tool(description = "Login with email and password. Returns JWT token.")]
136:     async fn auth_login(
137:         &self,
138:         params: Parameters<LoginInput>,
139:     ) -> Result<Json<LoginOutput>, String> {
140:         let input = params.0;
141:         // Rate limit by email
142:         self.state.rate_limiter.check(&input.email).await.map_err(|e| format!("Rate limited: {e}"))?;
143: 
144:         let user = queries::get_user_by_email(&self.state.db, &input.email)
145:             .await
146:             .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
147:             .ok_or_else(|| "Invalid email or password".to_string())?;
148: 
149:         let valid = jwt::verify_password(&input.password, &user.password)
150:             .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
151:         if !valid {
152:             return Err("Invalid email or password".into());
153:         }
154: 
155:         let token = jwt::create_token(user.id, &self.state.config.jwt_secret)
156:             .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
157: 
158:         Ok(Json(LoginOutput {
159:             token,
160:             user_id: user.id.to_string(),
161:             name: user.name,
162:         }))
163:     }

165:     #[tool(description = "Get user info from a JWT token")]
166:     async fn auth_me(
167:         &self,
168:         params: Parameters<MeInput>,
169:     ) -> Result<Json<MeOutput>, String> {
170:         let claims = jwt::validate_token(&params.0.token, &self.state.config.jwt_secret)
171:             .map_err(|e| format!("Invalid token: {e}"))?;
172: 
173:         let user_id = Uuid::parse_str(&claims.sub)
174:             .map_err(|_| "Invalid user ID in token".to_string())?;
175: 
176:         let user = queries::get_user_by_id(&self.state.db, user_id)
177:             .await
178:             .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
179:             .ok_or_else(|| "User not found".to_string())?;
180: 
181:         Ok(Json(MeOutput {
182:             user_id: user.id.to_string(),
183:             email: user.email,
184:             name: user.name,
185:         }))
186:     }

38: /// Get Telegram bot tokens from the database for a user
39: async fn get_telegram_bot_tokens(state: &AppState) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
40:     // Query integrations table for telegram provider

42:         .await
43:         .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to get integrations: {}", e))?;

49:             tokens.push(integration.access_token);

- exchange_code iterates all bot tokens looking for /connect {code}, stores chat_id as access_token
- publish sends text/photo/video/media_group through first configured token
- max_content_length=4096, editor_type=Html correct
